Root cause: "'`src/controllers/write/topics.js` invokes asynchronous `api.topics.create` directly. No actor-scoped in-flight state exists at this boundary. item.text:
Added `lockPosting` in [topics.js](/app/src/controllers/write/topics.js:16). Topic creates and replies now share an actor scoped lock, so overlapping requests from the same user or guest session are rejected. The existing route handler returns HTTP 400 with `status.code: "bad-request"` for the rejected request; a successful create keeps its `ok` response.

Three focused regression tests pass, as do lint and `git diff --check`. The existing API and controller suites could not complete because the local test Redis connection was refused, so persisted counters and HTTP integration remain unverified locally. Details are in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
